title: Close a Store to Open a Pandora’s Box? The Effects of Store Closure on Sales, Omnichannel Shopping, and Mobile App Usage
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD: counties with a store closed in January 2016 vs control counties; treat_x_post switches on at month 7 for all 33 treated counties (verified in StoreData.csv). Regressions use a pooled treat dummy, month dummies and an inverse Mills ratio (reg y treat_x_post treat imr i.month), not unit FE; individual-level tables likewise use treat + i.month without customer FE. One adoption cohort, so not staggered.
design_notes: Aggregate county-month panel (66 counties x 18 months, 1,188 rows) for Tables 3-5; customer-month panels for Tables 6-10. Table 5 adds moderator interactions.
estimators_reported: pooled DiD with treat dummy and month FE (single date)
ineligible_specs_listed: Tables 3-4: treat_x_post treat imr i.month; pooled treated dummy, IMR control, single date
Table 5: adds moderator x treat_x_post interactions
Tables 6-10: customer-level treat_x_post treat i.month; no unit FE, single date
data_files_note: readme.txt: subsample of the original panel with disguised values (random numbers added, multiplied by random factors 1-1.1) under an NDA.
data_provenance_note: Values perturbed by additive noise and random multiplicative factors; subsample with no stated sampling rule.
screener_notes: Fails on timing (single closure date), on FE (pooled treat dummy) and on data (disguised).
